Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a clinician-facing record of my November 5, 2027 right-ankle reassessment and the running plan it authorized.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Clinician record — right-ankle reassessment and authorized running plan (November 5, 2027)", "folder": "Health records", "body": "Date of reassessment: November 5, 2027

Reason for record
Document the right-ankle reassessment and the exercise plan authorized at that visit.

Reassessment findings
- The clinician reviewed the symptom-free record.
- No focal tenderness was found.
- No swelling was found.
- No instability was found.
- No gait change was found.

Authorized running plan
- Two nonconsecutive 40-minute continuous easy runs per week.
- A third weekly run remains unapproved.
- Do not run on bike-commute days.

Bike-commute limits
- Tuesday and Thursday remain the only bike-commute days.
- Each leg remains capped at 25 minutes at easy effort.
- No additional bike day is authorized.

Strengthening and monitoring
- Continue ankle-and-calf strengthening three times per week.
- Check symptoms during each strengthening session and during the following day.
- Advance only when both the session check and the following-day check remain symptom-free.

Scope
This record reflects the November 5, 2027 clinician authorization as reported and preserves the stated limits: two nonconsecutive 40-minute easy runs, Tuesday/Thursday bike commuting only with a 25-minute-per-leg easy-effort cap, no running on commute days, continued strengthening and symptom checks, and no third run or additional bike day."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_045_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The record says the clinician reviewed Riley's symptom-free history on November 5, 2027 and found no focal tenderness, swelling, instability, or gait change. It records clearance for two nonconsecutive 40-minute continuous easy runs per week, no running on Tuesday or Thursday bike-commute days, ankle-and-calf strengthening three times per week, and advancement only when both the session and following day remain symptom-free.", "value": {"title": "Clinician record — right-ankle reassessment and authorized running plan (November 5, 2027)", "folder": "Health records", "body": "Date of reassessment: November 5, 2027

- Two nonconsecutive 40-minute continuous easy runs per week.

- Do not run on bike-commute days.

Bike-commute limits
- Tuesday and Thursday remain the only bike-commute days.
- Each leg remains capped at 25 minutes at easy effort.
- No additional bike day is authorized.

Strengthening and monitoring
- Continue ankle-and-calf strengthening three times per week.
- Check symptoms during each strengthening session and during the following day.
- Advance only when both the session check and the following-day check remain symptom-free.

Scope
This record reflects the November 5, 2027 clinician authorization as reported and preserves the stated limits: two nonconsecutive 40-minute easy runs, Tuesday/Thursday bike commuting only with a 25-minute-per-leg easy-effort cap, no running on commute days, continued strengthening and symptom checks, and no third run or additional bike day."}}]}
